title: Cún đội khăn xếp
lesson: Muốn mượn đồ thì phải hỏi trước.
look: Same village yard as the first frame: flat dirt yard, thatched hut, banana trees, bamboo fence. Boy in royal-blue áo dài and a rigid black pleated flat-topped khăn xếp (never a turban); fluffy golden puppy.

beats.action: the boy bows and takes off his khăn xếp, puts it gently on a low wooden stool beside him to tie his sash; the puppy watches it with sparkling curious eyes, tail wagging
the puppy tiptoes like a sneaky cartoon spy, grabs the soft khăn xếp with its mouth and plops it on its own head, it slides over one eye; the boy turns around, eyes pop wide, mouth makes a big O

the puppy trots proudly in a circle around the flat yard wearing the hat, the boy jogs slowly after it on the flat ground, laughing, arms out; they go round and round, chickens flap out of the way, leaves swirl

the puppy stops, sits, tilts its head with the hat crooked and gives a funny proud face; the boy kneels, giggles and says the first line, then gently straightens the hat on the puppy's head and says the second line with a kind smile, wagging a finger softly

lines.text: Ơ! Khăn của anh đâu rồi?
Cún đội giống ông nội ghê! Hì hì!
Lần sau muốn mượn thì hỏi anh nhé!
